notes: Photo replies from the vision endpoint finally arrive. The raw-body logging added in 0.19.8 caught the culprit red-handed: the endpoint answers streamed requests with 'Error initializing the stream: HTTP 409' — the worker, as deployed, cannot stream at all, so every streamed photo-read was doomed regardless of GPU health. The app now detects that reply, immediately re-sends the same request as a single whole-JSON completion (which the worker handles fine), and remembers the endpoint as non-streaming so future photo-reads skip the doomed attempt entirely. Changing the vision endpoint ID in Settings forgets the learned quirk, in case a future deployment does stream.
